QuestInfo.name: The Puppeteer's Warning
QuestInfo.0: What would #p1002104# say about the Black Wings? You should talk to #b#p1002104##k, the Information Dealer in #b#m104000000##k, and find out.
QuestInfo.1: He tells you that the Black Wings are an organization conspiring to resurrect the Black Mage and says that this information must be relayed to #b#p1201000##k as well, so he wants you to let #p1201000# know about the situation.  In the meantime, Tru plans on utilizing his network as an Information Dealer to gather as much information on the Black Wings as possible.
QuestInfo.2: #p1201000# urged you to keep training, since the existence of the Black Wings means that the Black Mage has returned.

0.msg: Hm? I haven't found anything good on gathering jobs just yet... Did you need something else? Got any interesting news for me?\n\r\n

1.msg: (You tell him about meeting the Black Wings Puppeteer.)

2.msg: So, #p1204001# is the Puppeteer for the Black Wings? It all makes sense now... The Puppeteer must be the one behind the strange behavior of the #o1210102# monsters at #m100000000# and the feral actions of the Golems at #m101000000#. But... Did he mention the Black Mage?

3.msg: Come to think of it, there have been reports of a group that has been trying to awaken the Black Mage. I always thought it was just a rumor. Turns out it wasn't. Could the prophecies be true? Is it possible that the Black Mage could return?

4.msg: I think the Black Wings are worth investigating. They may be secretive, but they won't be able to sneak under #p1002104# the Information Dealer's radar. If I find anything out, I'll let you know. Head to #b#m140000000##k and tell #b#p1201000##k about this.

5.msg: The return of the hero, the followers of the Black Mage, and the prophecy... All of these things are connected. As the one who woke the hero, #p1201000# should be in the loop about all this. #p1201000# has been researching heroes for quite some time, so I'm sure she'll be able to help.

no.0: You don't want to give #p1201000# the dangerous news? She may seem weak on the outside, but remember, she lived alone on that island a long time, just to find you. She's much stronger than you think.

npc.0: Haven't you gone to #m140000000# yet? For anything to do with the Black Mage, you should definitely keep #p1201000# in the loop.
